candidates.label: Glass-cannon anchor (flat 20-46 assassin) — the proven high-engage operating point
candidates.rationale: Re-seed the historically strongest band (true-glass-cannon 20-46 topped 0.68 in an earlier run) as this cycle's score anchor and to try to retake the 1,3,3 cell from baseline. ~20px is the confirmed sweet spot (tighter 16-38 scored lower).

candidates.label: Ready-aware hit-run: hug 30-60 when Q up, pull to 60-100 on CD, retreat <45% HP
candidates.rationale: Island mutation of the long-running ready-aware-hitrun elite (branches on cooldown state, which a flat sweep can't). Commit tight on a ready skill, pull to mid while recharging, disengage below 45% HP — balances output + survival, the two heaviest judge terms.

candidates.label: All-in-when-hurt: kite 100-160 healthy, DIVE 18-44 below 45% HP
candidates.rationale: Targets the empty lower-durability bins (every elite is dur bin3). Inverts retreat-on-low-HP: cautious kite at full, then a desperate point-blank all-in when hurt to end the fight before dying — should end fights at a visibly lower hpFracLeft, shifting the durability descriptor down a bin.

candidates.label: Pulse brawler: dash to 28-56 on either skill ready, settle 64-104 between
candidates.rationale: A pulsing mid-engage cadence distinct from the flat always-hug winner: point-blank when Q OR E is up (burst), settle to a bruiser mid-band while recharging. Aims for a different tempo descriptor (burstier) to probe an adjacent cell.

candidates.label: Steady mid-line fighter: flat 56-96, never flee, constant pressure
candidates.rationale: A disciplined constant mid-band (56-96) that neither hugs nor kites and never retreats — steady engagement + steady tempo, a middle descriptor between the 0.68 hugger and the 0.55 far sniper. Simple, non-passive, should score respectably and may claim a mid engage/tempo cell.
